product_metadata.title: Sunbeam Tea Drop 850-Watt Hot-Tea Maker, Black
features: All-in-one 850-watt tea maker for heating, steeping, and serving hot tea
28-ounce capacity; variable steeping control; keep-warm function
Accommodates bagged and loose tea; removable tea basket
Stylish glass teapot with generous handle and drip-free spout
Measures approximately 8-3/4 by 9 by 10-1/2 inches; 1-year warranty
description: Easily heat, steep, and serve hot tea using this convenient countertop appliance. Accommodating bagged and loose tea, the all-in-one tea maker brews up to 28 ounces of hot tea with variable steeping control to serve individual tastes. The unit offers a simple control knob for adjusting the settings, a front-access "on/off" switch, and a tea basket that is removable for convenient filling and cleaning. The hot-tea maker's keep-warm function ensures the last cup is as hot and flavorful as the first. In addition, the unit's stylish glass teapot with measuring marks and brushed chrome accents provides a generous handle and drip-free spout for graceful serving. An attractive addition to any kitchen counter, the 850-watt hot-tea maker measures approximately 8-3/4 by 9 by 10-1/2 inches and carries a one-year warranty.
